stories.headline: Garrett Wilson's Concussion Is My Whole Thesis: Give Me Ben, Lay 72.9 With brimley, and Somebody Wake Up Jackie

upset.why: Stroke The Post is a 24.4-point favorite with Garrett Wilson ruled out and still in its lineup. Ben has 8.9 banked, Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta stacked in Detroit's 28.75, Patrick Mahomes in Kansas City's 28.6 against a Jets team without Wilson, and Adonai Mitchell inheriting Wilson's targets.

intro: Thursday night I had Jacksonville minus 9.5, and I'm not sure I deserved to cash it. Jaguars 33, Ravens 10. Joe Fagnano went 10 of 18 for 60 yards and two interceptions in his first NFL start, and I've seen better quarterback play at a church picnic. Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 and hit Parker Washington for a 50-yard touchdown. Here's the bank, as best I can add it up from the box scores: Jackie aCHANe got about 21.7 from Chris Rodriguez Jr. (a touchdown and two catches) and Jakobi Meyers (4 for 65), the most in the league. Sheev got about 14.1 from Washington, brimley about 13.6 from Lawrence, and Ben Football Team about 8.9 from Bhayshul Tuten's 1-yard touchdown. Derrick Henry gave Send Nudes 57 yards on 17 carries, roughly 5.6. Zay Flowers (#StopAsianHate) and Rashod Bateman (ClutchJuice) combined for four catches and 12 receiving yards. The best Raven was Justice Hill, 85 yards and a 65-yard touchdown run, and he was on Jackie's bench. Of course he was.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and the total. I took VegasInsider's board, updated Friday night, and FanDuel's numbers as posted by EatDrinkAndSleepFootball on Thursday, and lined them up. They agree on every favorite. Where they were a half point apart I split the difference, so you'll see the 49ers at -9.75 and Bengals-Falcons at 52.75. Thursday points are in the bank, so each strip's Vegas environment only counts the guys who still have to play. Anybody ruled out on Friday's final report projects zero. That's four starters this week: Kyler Murray, Garrett Wilson, Mike Evans and A.J. Brown. One more warning: lineups are as they stood when our data was pulled early Thursday. If you fixed your team since then, your line moved and I don't know it yet.

The board in one breath. San Francisco is implied for 30.6 against the Raiders, the fattest number of the week. Detroit is 28.75 in Miami, Kansas City 28.6 against a Jets team without Garrett Wilson, Dallas 28.5 in Indianapolis, and Cincinnati 27.9 against Atlanta in Madrid, in the biggest total on the board, 52.75. The sewer: Arizona at 15.5 in Seattle, the Chargers at 17.5 against Houston, Philadelphia at 17.9 against the Giants in a 38.75 total, the lowest of the week, and the Jets at 18.9. Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye, which is why Wan'Dale Robinson is a zero in Jackie's lineup. Bucs at Bears goes Sunday night, and Bills at Vikings closes it out Monday.

sections.note: Ben Football Team. Garrett Wilson is out and still sits in Stroke's lineup at zero, Ben has 8.9 banked, and both Ben quarterbacks play in offenses implied for 28.6 or more.
p: Here's my dog, and yes, I've seen the number. Stroke The Post projects 155.6 to 131.2, a 24.4-point favorite. That's the closest game on the board, and it isn't close. Ben Football Team is 6-2 with a luck factor of +2.64, tied with Jackie for the luckiest in the league, and it's seventh in scoring at 123.5 a game. Stroke is 5-3 and third at 164.8. Every spreadsheet in this league hates Ben. That's why the number is 24.4, and that's why I'm on it.

Start with the hole. Garrett Wilson is out with a concussion, and as of Thursday's lineup he's still in Stroke's starting lineup, projected for zero. D'Andre Swift (16.58) and Michael Penix Jr. (17.0) are on the bench, and if Stroke swaps one of them in, this line goes to about 41 and I look like an idiot. But Wilson being out doesn't only hurt Stroke. Ben starts Adonai Mitchell (8.37) in that same Jets offense, and with Wilson gone, Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. are the receivers left to throw to. The defense they're throwing against belongs to Kansas City, implied for 28.6, and that's where Ben has Patrick Mahomes (21.24).

Now the quarterbacks. Ben has Jared Goff (19.97) and Sam LaPorta (13.45) together in Miami, Detroit implied for 28.75, the second-best offense on the board, plus Mahomes in the third-best. Stroke's quarterbacks are Matthew Stafford (18.48) against Washington and Caleb Williams (18.51) on Sunday night against Tampa Bay. Good spots, not better ones. Stroke's real juice is Cowboys-Colts in a 51.5 total: Javonte Williams (18.39) and CeeDee Lamb (20.19) for Dallas and Jonathan Taylor (17.5) for Indianapolis. Three Stroke starters in one game. If Dallas runs away with it, Taylor gets scripted out. If it's a shootout, I'm dead.

Ben has 8.9 in the bank from Tuten. James Cook III (14.99) for Stroke and T.J. Hockenson (10.75) for Ben meet Monday night in Minnesota, where the Vikings are playing without Kyler Murray, and Travis Kelce (13.19) is on Stroke's side of the Mahomes game. Is Ben the better team? No. Ben is not the better team. I'm saying 24.4 is a lot to lay when one of your starters is a zero. Ben straight up, and you can have my watch if I'm wrong.

sections.note: #StopAsianHate. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (24.18) and Kenneth Walker III (21.98) lead a 144.8 projection, and Gardner Minshew II in Arizona's 15.5 is the only soft spot.
p: This is the one that moves the playoff line. Panic Trade Project is 4-4 with the league's third-best luck, +2.45, and its lowest scoring, 92.4 a game. #StopAsianHate is 3-5 with the second-worst luck, -2.18, and is fifth in scoring at 147.3. If the 3-5 team wins, they're both 4-5. The 3-5 team projects 144.8 to 102.2, and it already has 5.3 banked from Zay Flowers, who caught three balls for six yards Thursday. Ugly, but banked.

#StopAsianHate's case is three guys. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (24.18) gets Arizona at home, with Seattle implied for 24.0 and Sam Darnold out. Kenneth Walker III (21.98) gets the Jets, Kansas City implied for 28.6, and Rashee Rice (15.7) is in the same offense and off the injury report. George Pickens (13.52) is questionable with the hamstring in Dallas, implied for 28.5. And C.J. Stroud (17.75) gets the Chargers in his first game for this team, Houston implied for 23.0.

The soft spot is Gardner Minshew II (11.53) in the superflex. Arizona is implied for 15.5 in Seattle, the lowest Sunday number on the board, so that's $23 of FAAB playing in a sewer. Panic can't punish it. Bo Nix (15.78) gets Carolina with Denver implied for 23.25, and Joe Milton (12.54) is in a Philadelphia offense implied for 17.9 with Tanner McKee questionable. Panic's three running backs, Tyler Goodson, Kimani Vidal and Devin Singletary, project 20.97 together. Singletary is the best of them because he's the Giants' last healthy back with Cam Skattebo doubtful. Emeka Egbuka (10.52) is questionable with the foot but practiced in full Thursday.

Panic's prayer is Sunday night: Rome Odunze (11.6) and Egbuka on opposite sides of Bucs-Bears, a 47.5 total. Two receivers in one game is a correlated prayer, but it's still a prayer. Smith-Njigba and Walker alone project 46.16, close to half of Panic's whole lineup. #StopAsianHate, and pay the man.

sections.note: brimley. Jackie aCHANe has three starters projected for zero, Kyler Murray, Kendrick Bourne and Wan'Dale Robinson, and the quarterback fix is sitting on its own bench.
p: Jackie aCHANe banked the most Thursday points in the league, about 21.7, and it is still a 72.9-point underdog. Let me explain how that's possible. Kyler Murray was ruled out with the hamstring. Kendrick Bourne is on injured reserve. Wan'Dale Robinson's Titans are on bye. That's three starting slots, one of them the quarterback, projected for zero in Thursday's lineup. Jackie projects 78.6.

Here's what makes me want to throw my phone: the fix is on the bench. Malik Willis (17.81) and Daniel Jones (15.01) are both there. Woody Marks (11.31) is there too, and with David Montgomery out again he's Houston's lead back. Willis for Murray alone gets Jackie to 96.4. There's no healthy receiver on the bench for the other two holes, but free agents cost nothing. If Jackie set the lineup Friday, good. If not, wake up.

brimley doesn't have a single starter in an offense implied for 25 or more, which normally gets my attention. Its Sunday environment is 20.4, the lowest in the league. Doesn't matter. Trevor Lawrence banked about 13.6 on Thursday. Jordan Love (17.4) and Christian Watson (16.2) stack in New England. Justin Jefferson (17.74) and DJ Moore (12.94) play each other Monday night. Trey McBride (15.4) is stuck in Arizona's 15.5. Saquon Barkley (12.83) has no designation, but he's been out-snapped by Elijah Mitchell, so I'm not counting on him. brimley still wins by about 55 if Jackie plays Willis, and by 73 if Jackie sleeps in. Lock. Both hands.

sections.note: Sheev. Brock Purdy gets the Raiders in the best offense on the board, and three ClutchJuice starters play for a Jets offense implied for 18.9.
p: The commissioner is 1-7 with a luck factor of -3.55, the worst in the league, and he's sixth in scoring. Half the league has scored less and won more. This week he finally gets a team that can't hurt him. ClutchJuice projects 69.9, the lowest total of the week, and its Thursday bank is 1.6, from Rashod Bateman's one catch for six yards. Sheev banked about 14.1 from Parker Washington's 50-yard touchdown.

Brock Purdy (22.19) gets the Raiders with San Francisco implied for 30.6, the top number of the week, and with Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel both out, there are fewer mouths to feed. Jayden Daniels (18.55) gets the Rams. Luther Burden III (14.66) is in Chicago's 26.9 on Sunday night. Breece Hall (8.38) is off the injury report and says he's good to go after missing five games with the quad.

Hall coming back is bad news for the other side. ClutchJuice's running backs are Braelon Allen (10.51) and Isaiah Davis (0.36), both Jets, and Hall is expected to split the backfield with Allen. Mason Taylor (7.54) is a Jet too. That's three ClutchJuice starters in an offense implied for 18.9, with Garrett Wilson out, against Kansas City. Drake Maye (21.13) gets Green Bay with New England implied for 24.4, and he's the only reason this line isn't 90. Jordan Watkins (1.82), a receiver, is in the superflex slot, and the bench has nothing better. Sheev. Give the man a win.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 goes for 9-0. Christian McCaffrey and Michael Wilson are cleared to play, Amon-Ra St. Brown is questionable, and God Bless Vodka has Nico Collins on its bench.
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 8-0 and projects 183.1, the highest total of the week. God Bless Vodka is 2-6 and projects 126.5. The only thing that can beat Bijan is the injury report, so let's read it. Michael Wilson (12.99) is expected to play through broken ribs, in Arizona's 15.5, the worst number on the Sunday board. Then it's Josh Allen (22.43) on Monday night against a Minnesota team without Kyler Murray, and Dak Prescott (19.77) in Indianapolis with Dallas implied for 28.5. Bijan Robinson (23.16) and Tee Higgins (16.58) are on opposite sides of Bengals-Falcons in Madrid, the biggest total of the week. Brock Bowers (18.71) and Ashton Jeanty (12.22) are Raiders, 9.75-point underdogs in San Francisco, which means Las Vegas will be throwing all afternoon. Bowers eats when the Raiders trail.

God Bless Vodka does have four starters in 25-plus offenses: Chase Brown (16.18) in Cincinnati, Xavier Worthy (10.29) in Kansas City, Jameson Williams (12.66) in Detroit and George Kittle (15.18) in San Francisco, where Evans and Deebo being out means more for Kittle. The problem is the quarterbacks. Geno Smith (14.63) is on the Jets at 18.9 without Garrett Wilson, and Justin Herbert (14.04) is on the Chargers at 17.5 with David Njoku doubtful. And as of Thursday, Nico Collins (17.81) is on the bench while Malik Washington (10.85) starts. Move him, fellas. It's free. Bijan to 9-0.

sections.note: Send Nudes. Mike Evans and A.J. Brown are out, and the champs still have five starters in offenses implied for 25-plus, including Jahmyr Gibbs, the top projection of the week.
p: The champs are playing with two empty slots and they're still a 44.6-point favorite. Mike Evans is out with the Achilles and A.J. Brown with the ankle and knee, and both were still in Send Nudes' lineup Thursday morning. Keenan Allen (11.35), Rachaad White (10.66) and Aaron Jones Sr. (9.63) are on the bench. The rest is a heater. Joe Burrow (21.35) and Ja'Marr Chase (19.72) stack in Madrid in the biggest total on the board. Jahmyr Gibbs (25.8), the top projection of any starter this week, gets Miami with Detroit at 28.75. Puka Nacua (23.13) and Kyren Williams (18.65) both go at Washington with the Rams implied for 26.5. Kirk Cousins (17.38) quarterbacks a Raiders team that'll be chasing all day.

Very Naughty Boys is 0-8 but has averaged 119.4 over its last three games, which is the scariest thing about it. Its one starter in a 25-plus offense is Colston Loveland (11.05), in Chicago on Sunday night. J.J. McCarthy (16.42) starts for the Giants as a 3-point road favorite in Philadelphia, in the lowest total of the week. Dalton Kincaid (9.74) and Jordan Addison (8.48) are on opposite sides of Bills-Vikings on Monday. Very Naughty Boys' tight ends, Loveland and Kincaid, project 20.79, more than Tyler Warren's 13.23. That's the edge. It isn't 44 points of edge. Send Nudes.

Rashee Rice (#StopAsianHate), Travis Kelce (Stroke The Post), Christian Watson and DJ Moore (brimley), Mason Taylor (ClutchJuice) and Denzel Boston (Ben) are not on their teams' final reports.

Thursday is done. Bhayshul Tuten (Ben) played through his questionable ankle and foot and scored from a yard out. Lamar Jackson (Sheev) is on injured reserve with the thumb, and Tyler Huntley (brimley) was out with a toe injury, which is how Joe Fagnano (Sheev bench) came to make his first start: 10 of 18, 60 yards, two interceptions.

Elsewhere: Sam Darnold (Very Naughty Boys bench) is out with a quad injury, so Seattle turns to Drew Lock, who has an elbow issue of his own. DeVonta Smith (Bijan, injured reserve) misses his third game with the hamstring. Terrance Ferguson (Stroke The Post) was set to come off injured reserve and instead has a new hamstring injury. The prescription this week is simple: check the four starters who were ruled out, and check them again before your first kickoff.

lead.headline: Sheev Buys the Ravens: Lamar by Trade, His Rookie Replacement for $7, and Four Teams Chase Minshew
lead.deck: Lamar Jackson's thumb ran the wire: #StopAsianHate traded him and a third for C.J. Stroud and won Gardner Minshew II at $23, the league spent $49 on 12 claims, and 5-3 Jackie aCHANe heads into Week 9 with two empty starting slots.

stories.headline: One Thumb, Four Bids, $23: The Lamar Effect
paragraphs: Here's what I'm hearing: one thumb moved this whole wire. Lamar Jackson went down on Baltimore's first offensive snap Sunday, the Ravens say he needs surgery and could miss the rest of the season, and by Wednesday morning four league teams had bid on quarterbacks. Twelve claims have cleared since our last edition for $49 in all, and $23 of it went to one player.

#StopAsianHate is the team that had to move. With Lamar out, Jalen Hurts on injured reserve and Deshaun Watson a questionable backup in Cleveland, it traded Lamar and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third to Sheev on Tuesday for C.J. Stroud. Mona Lott has the grade below. On Wednesday it won Gardner Minshew II at $23 over brimley ($17), Sheev ($8) and Jackie ($5). Minshew is Arizona's starter and goes straight into the superflex slot at 11.53, though Arizona is implied for just 15.5 points against Seattle. To make room, #StopAsianHate cut Tyrone Tracy Jr., the running back it paid $37 for in Week 6, who is now on the Giants' injured reserve. It also paid $2 for Ray Davis on Friday. It has $12 left.

Sheev went the other way and bought Baltimore's quarterbacks. It took on Lamar in the trade, then paid $7 for Joe Fagnano, the undrafted rookie starting tonight against Jacksonville, beating #StopAsianHate and brimley at $1 each. Fagnano sits on Sheev's bench at 10.31 behind Jayden Daniels and Brock Purdy, and Baltimore is implied for 14.75, the lowest number on the board. The detail everyone missed: Sheev already had Baltimore's backup. It cut Tyler Huntley on Sunday morning for Pat Freiermuth at $0, hours before Lamar got hurt. Huntley then hurt his toe in relief, brimley claimed him Wednesday for $1, and he's listed out. Freiermuth's Pittsburgh is on bye this week. Sheev is down to $3, the least in the league.

The return desk stayed busy. Ben Football Team paid $5 for Colts running back DJ Giddens on Sunday and released him Wednesday; he projects 0.18. brimley paid $5 on Friday for Jaydon Blue, beating Panic Trade Project's $2, cut him Monday for free agent Roschon Johnson, then cut Roschon on Wednesday for Huntley. Send Nudes claimed Courtland Sutton for $0 on Sunday, releasing Colby Parkinson four days after paying $4 for him, then released Sutton and Chig Okonkwo, last week's $6 winner, on Wednesday. The champs now have two open roster spots and one tight end, Tyler Warren. Sutton, for the record, was Sheev's until last Thursday, when Sheev dropped him for Tank Dell.

Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 cut Justice Hill one day after paying $3 for him. Jackie aCHANe, which lost that auction at $1, paid $4 to get him on Sunday and cut Zonovan Knight, my best value from last week, to do it. Hill is on Jackie's bench at 5.98. Bijan also paid $2 for Patriots receiver Efton Chism III and picked up Brandon Aiyuk as a free agent for Samaje Perine, a stash with no Week 9 projection. Panic's $0 claim on Jalen McMillan cleared Saturday; he's on Tampa Bay's injured reserve with a knee injury.

ClutchJuice turned its receivers over again. Last week I said it did the most with the least by adding Cooper Kupp and Kalif Raymond for $0. By Sunday night both were gone: Raymond for New England's Kyle Williams, Kupp for Bears tight end Sam Roush, and Darius Cooper for 49ers backup Mac Jones. Sheev had a $0 claim in on Williams that failed for lack of roster space. Williams starts at flex this week at 3.6. Raymond projects 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, and nobody owns either one.

So my best value this week isn't a claim. It's what's sitting there. Sutton projects 7.9, Raymond 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, all unowned. Jackie aCHANe is 5-3, plays brimley, has two empty starting slots and no healthy receiver on its bench. Raymond and Kupp are free agents, so they cost nothing. That's the most important pickup in the league this week, and as of Thursday morning nobody has made it.

Who has money left: God Bless Vodka $96, Send Nudes $94, brimley $68, Bijan $65, Stroke The Post $64 and Ben $58. Then Very Naughty Boys $26, Panic $14, #StopAsianHate $12, ClutchJuice $9, Jackie $5 and Sheev $3. Stroke didn't make a claim this week and still has the fifth-biggest budget.

stories.headline: A Rookie in Baltimore, Two Empty Slots for Jackie, and Three Games That Move the Playoff Line
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood makes those Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 9. Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye, and the only league starter it hits is Jackie aCHANe's Wan'Dale Robinson. Jackie also has Kendrick Bourne, who is on injured reserve, in its lineup, so it enters the week with two starters projected for nothing.

Tonight it's Jacksonville at Baltimore, and Baltimore is starting Joe Fagnano, an undrafted rookie, with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve and Tyler Huntley hurt. Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite and the total is 39.5, which implies 24.75 points for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens, the lowest team total of the week. Eight league starters play. On the Baltimore side: Derrick Henry for Send Nudes, Zay Flowers for #StopAsianHate and Rashod Bateman for ClutchJuice. On the Jacksonville side: Trevor Lawrence for brimley, Parker Washington for Sheev, Bhayshul Tuten (questionable) for Ben Football Team, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Jakobi Meyers for Jackie.

Follow the implied totals. San Francisco is a 10-point favorite over Las Vegas with a 52.5 total, which implies 31.25 points, the most of the week. Kansas City and Detroit are next at 28.75, then Dallas at 28.5 and Cincinnati at 27.75. The bottom of the board is Baltimore at 14.75, Arizona at 15.5, Philadelphia at 17.5 and the Chargers at 18.0. Send Nudes has six starters in offenses implied for 25 or more. Stroke The Post has five and the highest average, 25.27 points per starter. brimley and Jackie have none, and brimley's starters average 20.8, the lowest in the league. Our two sources agree on every favorite this week.

The game of the week is Stroke The Post against Ben Football Team, because it's the closest projection on the board and it's still 33.6 points, 169.9 to 136.3. Ben is 6-2, but it's seventh in scoring at 123.5 a game and its opponents have averaged 110.9, the second-softest schedule in the league. Its all-play record is 3.36 wins, and its luck factor, +2.64, is tied with Jackie's for the highest. Stroke has played like a 6.09-win team, third-best. The gap is receiver, 68.8 to 27.1. Ben's case is tight end, where it leads by 11.0, and Mahomes in an offense implied for 28.75.

Now the playoff line. Six teams get in and the regular season ends in Week 14, so there are six games left. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 8-0, Send Nudes and Ben are 6-2, and three teams are 5-3: Stroke, brimley and Jackie, which holds sixth. Panic Trade Project is 4-4, and #StopAsianHate and ClutchJuice are 3-5. This week has three games that move that line: Stroke against Ben, brimley against Jackie and Panic against #StopAsianHate. In the middle one, Jackie projects 88.9 to brimley's 157.6, with two empty slots it can fill for free off the wire. Projections don't account for lineup changes that haven't happened yet.

Two more things for the file. Bijan projects 183.1, the top total of the week, but Christian McCaffrey, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Michael Wilson are all questionable, 56.19 points between them. And ClutchJuice projects 72.9, the lowest of the week, against Sheev's 137.0, with a receiver in its superflex slot. ClutchJuice has the best lineup efficiency in the league, 97%. stories.headline: One Snap, One Point, and a Bench Nobody Needed: How Week 8 Was Decided
intro: The league averaged 133.87 points in Week 8, down 3.26 from Week 7. Send Nudes' 211.96 was the top score, the fourth-highest by any team this season, and Panic Trade Project's 72.68 was the lowest, its own season low. Favorites won four of six games. One of the two that didn't was decided by 1.18 points, and the other on Baltimore's first offensive snap.

Bijan Your Face is 8-0 and the only unbeaten team left. Send Nudes and Ben Football Team are 6-2. Stroke The Post, brimley and Jackie aCHANe are 5-3, and Jackie holds the sixth and final playoff spot on the tiebreaker despite the eighth-most points in the league. Panic Trade Project is a game back at 4-4. Six weeks remain in the regular season. Here is every game.

p: Jackie aCHANe beat Sheev 116.86 to 115.68. That 1.18-point margin is the third-closest game of the season. Sheev was a 3.2-point favorite on Sunday's lineup projections, and Jeff Longwood took Jackie as his upset of the week. He got it.

Jackie built the win on Thursday night in Green Bay. Matthew Golden scored 20.9, Tucker Kraft 17.3 and Bryce Young 11.36, and Jackie went into Sunday with 49.56 points to Sheev's 11.8. Kyler Murray added 20.9 and Wan'Dale Robinson 15.7. Jackie could have made it easier: Malik Willis scored 15.64 on the bench while Young started, and Justice Hill, a $4 waiver claim this week, scored 7.5 on the bench while Kendrick Bourne started and scored 3.9.

Sheev came back on Monday night. Luther Burden III scored 18.6 for the Bears against Seattle, the most points by any player in that game on either roster, and Zach Charbonnet added 5.9, against 4.3 from Jackie's AJ Barner. It came up 1.18 short. Here is the detail that hurts: Sheev's lineup was the best it could legally field. The only bench player who scored, Oronde Gadsden with 10.2, is on the taxi squad and couldn't be started. Harold Fannin Jr. scored 23.4 and Pat Freiermuth, a $0 waiver claim that Send Nudes had dropped in Week 7, scored 11.6. Parker Washington scored 3.6 against a 15.48 projection, and that was the game. One more thing: Sheev dropped Courtland Sutton for Tank Dell this week. Dell scored 0.0 on Sheev's bench. Sutton scored 9.3 on Send Nudes' bench.
sections.note: Sheev is 1-7 with the sixth-most points in the league and the worst luck rating, -3.55. Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 and holds sixth. Next week: Sheev plays ClutchJuice, Jackie plays brimley.

p: Ben Football Team beat #StopAsianHate 130.58 to 112.96. #StopAsianHate was a 25.9-point favorite and Jeff's game of the week pick. It was the only pick Jeff lost.

Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on Baltimore's first play in Buffalo, when his hand hit a pass rusher as he threw. He played one snap and scored 0.0 in #StopAsianHate's superflex spot. The Ravens say he is headed for surgery and injured reserve. Baltimore's backup, Tyler Huntley, hurt his toe in the second quarter, the Bills won 36-10, and Zay Flowers scored 0.0 against an 18.45 projection. That is 38.95 projected points from one offense that turned into nothing. George Pickens added 6.8.

Lamar's injury could not have been planned for. The rest could have been. Kenny Gainwell scored 14.0 on the bench, Blake Corum 13.3 and Ladd McConkey 12.6. Swap Gainwell in for Flowers and McConkey in for Pickens, leave Lamar's zero exactly where it was, and #StopAsianHate wins 132.76 to 130.58. Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 23.8 on Monday night and Jaylen Warren 21.3.

Ben Football Team won while leaving 52.9 points on its own bench, the most in the league this week. Adonai Mitchell scored 27.2 and Emmett Johnson 25.3 on the bench, while Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.0 and DK Metcalf 1.4 in the lineup. It didn't matter, because Bhayshul Tuten scored 29.9 against Indianapolis, Patrick Mahomes 25.44 and Chuba Hubbard 24.9.
sections.note: Ben Football Team is 6-2 with the seventh-most points in the league and a +2.64 luck rating, tied with Jackie aCHANe for the best. #StopAsianHate is 3-5 and two games out of sixth, and its quarterback room now has a hole in it.

p: Bijan Your Face beat Very Naughty Boys 199.56 to 135.2, and it is 8-0. Tee Higgins scored 37.5 against Tennessee on a 15.97 projection. Brock Bowers scored 28.2, Josh Allen 27.56 against Baltimore, Michael Wilson 26.8 and Josh Jacobs 23.2 on Thursday night. Bijan Robinson, the team's namesake, scored 7.6 against a 22.14 projection, and it didn't matter. Jaylen Waddle (14.9) and Ryan Flournoy (13.1) both outscored him from the bench.

Very Naughty Boys scored 135.2, its best score of the season by 20.78 points, and it wasn't close to enough. Jonah Coleman scored 20.4, Dalton Kincaid 18.6 and Sam Darnold 18.52. Very Naughty Boys did cover Jeff's 79.5-point line, which is the kind of moral victory you get at 0-8.
sections.note: Bijan Your Face has scored 1,502.5 points, 93.7 more than anyone else, and averages 187.8 a week. Very Naughty Boys is 0-8, the only winless team. Next week Bijan plays God Bless Vodka; Very Naughty Boys gets Send Nudes.

p: Send Nudes beat God Bless Vodka 211.96 to 116.96, the week's top score. Joe Burrow scored 42.48 against Tennessee, the most by any player in the league this week, and Ja'Marr Chase added 31.1. That's 73.58 points from one Cincinnati passing game. Kirk Cousins scored 28.18, Puka Nacua 25.0 and Jahmyr Gibbs 24.8.

Last week Send Nudes lost with Cousins on its bench. This week Cousins started over Aaron Rodgers, who scored 5.88 on the bench, and Send Nudes set a perfect lineup: 211.96 out of a possible 211.96. The only soft spot was Tyler Warren, 5.8 against an 11.09 projection.

Tyler Allgeier scored 36.1 on it, more than any running back in a starting lineup in the league this week, while Jeremiyah Love started in his first game back from his ankle injury and scored 2.3. Jake Ferguson, now listed out with an ankle injury, started and scored 0.0. God Bless Vodka left 43.8 points on the bench. stories.headline: Jeff Longwood Went 5-1, Lamar Played One Snap, and I Have Some Apologizing to Do
paragraphs: I have to start with an apology, and I hate it. Last week I said the toilet bowl was officially Jeff Longwood. This week Jeff went 5-1. His upset pick, Jackie aCHANe over the commissioner, hit by 1.18 points. His lock, Bijan Your Face, won by 64.36. The only pick he lost was #StopAsianHate, and he lost it because a quarterback got hurt on the first play of the game. Jeff, I'm sorry. Please stop texting me screenshots.

Let's talk about that first play. Lamar Jackson came back from three missed games, Dr. Wang cleared him, he played, and he lasted exactly one snap before his thumb hit a Buffalo pass rusher. He scored 0.0. Zay Flowers scored 0.0. #StopAsianHate lost by 17.62 with Kenny Gainwell's 14.0 and Ladd McConkey's 12.6 on the bench. I can't blame anyone for the thumb. I can blame someone for George Pickens' 6.8 starting over McConkey, and I will.

Ben Football Team left 52.9 points on its bench, the most in the league, and won anyway. Adonai Mitchell scored 27.2 on the bench. Emmett Johnson scored 25.3 on the bench. Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.0 in the lineup. This team is 6-2 with the seventh-most points in the league, and Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 with the eighth-most. Both have a +2.64 luck rating, best in the league. Panic Trade Project has the fewest points in the league and is 4-4. Somebody check the schedule-maker's bank account.

Speaking of which, the commissioner. Sheev lost by 1.18 with the best lineup it could legally set. Nothing on the bench could have saved it. Sheev also dropped Courtland Sutton this week to pick up Tank Dell. Dell scored zero. Sutton scored 9.3 for Send Nudes, on the bench, because Send Nudes has so much depth it doesn't need him. Sheev is 1-7 with the sixth-most points in the league and the worst luck rating in the league, -3.55. Next week it plays ClutchJuice, which just scored 85.56. I said this last week too. I'm saying it again. Win the game, Commissioner.

Two quick ones. God Bless Vodka benched Tyler Allgeier, and Allgeier scored 36.1, more than any running back who actually started in this league. Jeremiyah Love, who started instead, scored 2.3. And the Bengals: Joe Burrow scored 42.48 and Ja'Marr Chase 31.1 for Send Nudes, and Tee Higgins scored 37.5 for Bijan Your Face. Three Bengals combined for 111.08 points against Tennessee, and the two teams that own them both won. Next week Bijan plays God Bless Vodka. God Bless Vodka should start Allgeier. It won't matter, but it should.

breakdown.headline: 1-7, Second in Value, and the Trade That Put It There
p: Sheev is 1-7 and second in dynasty value, up two spots to 68,932. It gained 2,407 since last Sunday, the most of any team in the league. It scores 141.6 a game, sixth, against the second-toughest schedule in the league, 152.6 a game. Its all-play record is 4.55 wins and its luck factor is -3.55, still the worst in the league. The projected win total is 4.3.

Most of the gain is one trade. On Tuesday Sheev sent C.J. Stroud to #StopAsianHate for Lamar Jackson and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third. Lamar is worth 5,469 even on injured reserve with his thumb, and Stroud is worth 4,023, so Sheev added about 1,446 in player value plus a pick worth 1,083. The rest of the roster drifted down: Tetairoa McMillan lost 377, Parker Washington 328, Quinshon Judkins 309 and Brock Purdy 294. Harold Fannin Jr. was the riser, up 331.

The quarterback room is the most valuable part of the roster: Purdy (5,921), Jayden Daniels (5,749) and Lamar are the three most valuable players on the team. Behind them are McMillan (4,301), Luther Burden III (4,127) and Washington (3,769). Forty-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, and the weighted age is 25.2.

The picks are where the record hurts. Sheev's own 2027 first belongs to Very Naughty Boys and projects early, worth 4,886. Its own 2027 second is Panic Trade Project's, its own 2027 third is Jackie aCHANe's, and in 2028 its first belongs to ClutchJuice, its second to Jackie and its third to brimley. In return it holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected late), Jackie's 2027 third, #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan's 2028 third: 8,162, seventh in the league.
breakdown.verdict: A roster built to win, a record that says otherwise, and every loss makes Very Naughty Boys' pick better.
breakdown.move: Lamar won't help this season. If a contender loses a quarterback, sell one of the three, ideally for a running back, because Sheev's backfield is Breece Hall coming off a five-week absence.

breakdown.headline: 2-6, the Most FAAB in the League, and an Early First Someone Else Gets
p: God Bless Vodka is 2-6, scores 105.8 a game, ninth, and is 11th in dynasty value at 47,538, down 733. Its all-play record is 2.36 wins and its luck factor is -0.36, so the record is about what the scoring deserves. The projected win total is 4.0.

The diagnosis is still the draft capital. God Bless Vodka's 2027 first and second belong to Bijan, and that first projects early, worth 4,886. Its 2028 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. What's left is its own 2027 third, its own 2028 second and third, and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 second: 4,825 in pick value, ninth in the league.

The roster lost value at the top. Jeremiyah Love (4,732), 21, is still the most valuable player on the team and is on injured reserve; he lost 676 this week. Nico Collins (3,703) lost 319 and Omarion Hampton (2,775) lost 318. The one riser was Tyler Allgeier, up 434 to 1,546, and with Love on IR and Zonovan Knight out, he's Arizona's lead back this week. Forty-two percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.

One more thing for the chart. God Bless Vodka has spent $4 of its FAAB all season, and its $96 is the most left in the league. It has used almost none of it, and Collins (17.81 projected) started the week on its bench.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild without its own first-round pick, which means losing helps Bijan, not God Bless Vodka.
breakdown.move: Sell George Kittle and Collins to contenders for 2027 picks now, and spend the $96 on young players the wire keeps producing.

breakdown.headline: Still Second, Oldest in the League, and Losing Value Fastest
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see Send Nudes in December. They shouldn't. The champs are 5-2, second in scoring at 171.0 a game, and project for 10.9 wins. They're also second in dynasty value at 70,613, and they lost 3,012 since last Sunday, the biggest drop of any team in the league.

The drop is the price of an old roster. A.J. Brown fell 449 and is out this week, Derrick Henry fell 393 at 32.8 years old, and even Jahmyr Gibbs gave back 342. Thirty-seven percent of the value sits in players 29 or older, the highest share in the league, and the weighted age, 28.2, is the oldest. The quarterback room is Joe Burrow, Kirk Cousins (38.2), Baker Mayfield (31.6) and Aaron Rodgers (42.9). Burrow was the one riser, up 319.

The waiver work was small and didn't stick. Chig Okonkwo ($6) replaced Pat Freiermuth and Colby Parkinson ($4) replaced Christian Kirk, and both have since been released. The top of the roster is still elite: Gibbs (10,238), Ja'Marr Chase (8,336) and Puka Nacua (8,028) are three of the six most valuable players in the league.
The picks don't help much. Send Nudes owns two 2027 thirds, its own and Ben Football Team's, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. That's 6,760 in pick value, and no 2027 first or second.
breakdown.verdict: A title team with three young stars and a lot of value aging out around them.
breakdown.move: Sell one of the veteran quarterbacks, Cousins or Mayfield, while a contender still needs one, and push the 2028 first into the title run only for a starter under 27.

breakdown.headline: More Value in Picks Than Players, and a Quarterback Who Scored 28 on Thursday
p: ClutchJuice is 2-4, scores 91.0 a game, 11th, and is 10th in dynasty value at 51,614. The number that matters: its picks are worth 27,137, the most in the league, and its players are worth 24,477. No other team in the league has picks worth more than its roster.

The roster is built around Drake Maye (7,157), 24, who scored 28.44 on Thursday. Germie Bernard (2,362) gained 537 this week and Kyle Pitts Sr. (2,221) gained 337. Eighty-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, the highest share in the league. On Tuesday it added Anthony Richardson Sr. (849) from Very Naughty Boys for its 2028 fifth-round pick.

Here's the pick list. In 2027: its own first (projected early, 5,103), brimley's and #StopAsianHate's firsts (both projected mid), its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's seconds, and #StopAsianHate's and Very Naughty Boys' thirds. In 2028: its own first and Sheev's first, its own second, and its own and brimley's thirds.
The projected win total is 2.6, which is fine. Every loss improves the 2027 first.
breakdown.verdict: The league's biggest pick stash, a starting quarterback, and not much else yet.
breakdown.move: Turn two of the three 2027 firsts into one young running back or receiver who's already producing. Three firsts in one draft is more than one roster can use.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, Two Quarterbacks Rising, and Up to Fourth
p: brimley is 5-3, fourth in scoring at 161.2 a game, and has faced 155.9 a game, still the toughest schedule in the league. Its all-play record is 5.82 wins and its luck factor is -0.82. Dynasty value rose 1,502 to 67,518, up one spot to fourth, and the projected win total is 9.4.

The gains came from the quarterbacks. Trevor Lawrence (6,045) gained 353 and Jordan Love (4,883) gained 289, and Shedeur Sanders, on the taxi squad, gained 391 to 1,137 and is expected to start for Cleveland this week. Bucky Irving (3,990) gained 238. Trey McBride (7,020) and Malik Nabers (6,710) are the two most valuable players on the roster, with Justin Jefferson (5,496) behind them. Tre Tucker lost 178.

The waiver work this week was churn. It paid $5 for Jaydon Blue and cut him, picked up and released Roschon Johnson, and claimed Tyler Huntley for $1, who is out with a toe injury. It lost the Gardner Minshew II auction to #StopAsianHate, $17 to $23. It has $68 left.

The draft capital is in the middle: its own 2027 second and third, Stroke The Post's 2027 third, its own 2028 first and second, and Sheev's 2028 third, 8,343, sixth in the league. Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice. Only 24% of the value is in players 25 or younger, second-lowest in the league after Stroke The Post.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff team that has played the hardest schedule in the league, with an older roster than the rank suggests.
breakdown.move: Don't sell. Use the 2028 second and some of the $68 to add a running back, because Saquon Barkley is losing snaps to Elijah Mitchell.

breakdown.headline: 4-3 With the League's Best Luck and a Pile of Picks
p: My sources say Panic Trade Project knows exactly what it is, and Friday's trade proves it. It sent Terrance Ferguson, an injured-reserve tight end, to Stroke The Post for Stroke's 2027 second-round pick. Ferguson had lost 161 in value since last Sunday. Panic got a pick worth 1,603 for a player now worth 1,616.

The standings say 4-3. The rest says rebuild. Panic scores 95.2 a game, 11th in the league, and its luck factor of +2.45 is the best in the league. The all-play record is 1.55 wins. It projects for 4.8 wins, and its lineup this week has four starters projected under 6.

Dynasty value is 57,598, seventh, and 84% of it is in players 25 or younger, second only to ClutchJuice. Too much of that value is hurt: Jaxson Dart (4,070) is on IR, and Carnell Tate (3,485) and Emeka Egbuka (3,228) are both out this week. Omar Cooper Jr. gained 343 and Makai Lemon gained 165. Jalen Coker lost 356 and Marvin Harrison Jr. lost 302.

The pick pile is the real asset: 17,519, third in the league. Panic owns two 2027 firsts (its own, projected mid, and Stroke The Post's, projected late), three 2027 seconds (Sheev's, Stroke The Post's and Ben Football Team's) and its own 2028 first, second and third, plus Stroke The Post's 2028 second and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 third.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild with a lucky record. The Ferguson trade was the right instinct.
breakdown.move: Don't buy at 4-3. Package two of the three 2027 seconds to move up into the first round, and keep stashing young receivers.

breakdown.headline: The Biggest Drop in the League, and a Quarterback Bought Twice
p: #StopAsianHate lost 5,114 in dynasty value since last Sunday, the biggest drop in the league, and fell three spots to sixth at 61,599. The cause is not mysterious. Lamar Jackson hurt his thumb on Baltimore's first snap, and two days later #StopAsianHate traded him and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third to Sheev for C.J. Stroud (4,023). It gave up a quarterback worth 5,469 and a pick worth 1,083 for a healthy one.

The Baltimore collapse hurt twice. Zay Flowers lost 605, the biggest single drop on the roster, and Thursday he caught three passes for six yards with an undrafted rookie throwing to him. Kenyon Sadiq lost 240, George Pickens 237 and Kenneth Walker III 226. On Wednesday it spent $23 on Gardner Minshew II (1,162) for the superflex slot and released Tyrone Tracy Jr., a $37 claim in Week 6.

The record still undersells the team. It's 3-5, fifth in scoring at 147.3 a game, against the third-toughest schedule, with a luck factor of -2.18, second-worst in the league. Its all-play mark, 5.18 wins, says 5-3. It projects for 6.9 wins. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (10,301) is the third most valuable player in the league, behind Josh Allen and Jahmyr Gibbs.

The future is mostly spent, and the prognosis there is unchanged. Its 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second belong to Sheev. What's left is its own 2027 second, ClutchJuice's 2027 third and its own 2028 third, 3,667 in pick value, 10th in the league. Thirty-two percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff-caliber lineup with a losing record, a thinner quarterback room than it had a week ago, and almost nothing in the pick drawer.
breakdown.move: Stay in it. Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, so losing doesn't help. Use the 2027 second to buy a quarterback better than Minshew before the deadline.

breakdown.headline: Six Wins, the Most Valuable Player in the League, and a First From God Bless Vodka
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 6-0, the last unbeaten team, and first in dynasty value at 91,566. The gap to second-place Send Nudes is 17,941, which is about the value of Bijan Robinson and Brock Bowers combined. It scores 184.8 a game, best in the league, and its projected win total is now 13.5.

The roster is built at the top. Josh Allen (10,740) is the most valuable player in the league, and he's on the bench this week only because Buffalo has a bye. Bijan Robinson (10,074), 24, Bowers (7,666), 23, and Ashton Jeanty (5,617), 22, give it three young cornerstones. Amon-Ra St. Brown (7,489) gained 558 in value since last Sunday. The losses were at the edges: Davante Adams (IR) fell 682 and Michael Wilson 464.
Age is the one thing to watch. Thirty percent of the value is in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey are both 30.4, and Dak Prescott is 33.3. Only 34% is 25 or younger.

The draft capital covers it. Bijan holds God Bless Vodka's 2027 first, and with God Bless Vodka at 1-5, it currently projects early and is worth 5,103. It also has God Bless Vodka's 2027 second, its own 2028 first and second, and Ben Football Team's 2028 first and third. Its own 2027 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. Pick value is 13,753, fifth. This week it spent $13 on Michael Mayer and $6 on Ryan Flournoy for depth.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league now, and an early first from a struggling team to restock later.
breakdown.move: Nothing big. Use the God Bless Vodka first or the Ben 2028 first to get younger at running back behind McCaffrey before his value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 0-6, Three 2027 Firsts, and a Tight End Who Just Got More Targets
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-6, scores 86.0 a game, last, and projects for 0.8 wins. Clinically, that's the plan working. Dynasty value rose 2,262 to 56,246, eighth.

Three trades in two days this week. It sent Anthony Richardson Sr. to ClutchJuice for a 2028 fifth, sent Chris Godwin Jr. and Justin Fields to Ben Football Team for Dontayvion Wicks, and added Austin Ekeler from God Bless Vodka for a 2027 fourth. Wicks is out this week with an ankle injury. J.J. McCarthy gained 994 in value and Colston Loveland (3,955) gained 549. Loveland scored 19.9 on Thursday, and Cole Kmet's knee injury could make him Chicago's only real tight end.
Sixty-five percent of the value is in players 25 or younger. Fernando Mendoza (3,990) on the taxi squad is the most valuable player on the roster.

The draft capital is the second-best in the league at 22,515. Very Naughty Boys holds three 2027 firsts: its own and Sheev's, both projected early at 5,103 each, and Send Nudes' (projected late). It also holds Send Nudes', Bijan's and its own 2027 seconds, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. Its own 2027 third belongs to ClutchJuice.
breakdown.verdict: The cleanest tank in the league, with two early firsts and a third that's late.
breakdown.move: Keep selling veterans for picks. Package the Send Nudes first with a second to move up if a top quarterback prospect is there.

breakdown.headline: Sixth in Value, No 2027 Picks, and Still Buying
p: Stroke The Post is 4-3, but the scoring says contender. It averages 170.8 a game, third in the league, and its all-play record of 5.55 wins is second only to Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. The luck factor is -1.55. It projects for 9.6 wins.

The value went the other way. Stroke The Post lost 2,625 and sits sixth at 65,395. Jonathan Taylor lost 795, the biggest single drop on the roster, and Garrett Wilson (401), Chris Olave (387) and Travis Kelce (295) all fell too. Michael Penix Jr. was the one real gain, up 299. Only 19% of the value is in players 25 or younger, the lowest share in the league.

Friday's trade was about Kelce, who is 37. Stroke sent its own 2027 second to Panic Trade Project for Terrance Ferguson, a 23-year-old tight end now on the Rams' injured reserve. The price was fair on value, 1,603 for 1,616. The cost is that Stroke now owns no 2027 picks at all.
What's left is its own 2028 first and third, 3,241 in pick value, second-fewest in the league after Ben Football Team. Every future move will have to be paid for with players.
breakdown.verdict: A top-three offense with an aging core and no 2027 draft capital.
breakdown.move: Win now, because the roster is built for it. Sell an aging back like Jonathan Taylor or D'Andre Swift after the season, before their value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 6-2, Tied for the Luckiest Record, and Last in Dynasty Value
p: Here's what I'm hearing: Ben Football Team is in second place and nobody's scared. The record is 6-2. The scoring is 123.5 a game, seventh, against the second-softest schedule in the league, 110.9 a game. The all-play record is 3.36 wins, and the luck factor, +2.64, is tied with Jackie aCHANe for the highest in the league. The projected win total is 8.6, because six wins are already banked.

Dynasty value is 40,281, 12th in the league, down 719. Patrick Mahomes (5,310) gained 394, Bhayshul Tuten (3,830) gained 388 and Chuba Hubbard (3,164) gained 282. The drops were at the bottom of the roster: Taylen Green lost 835 and Emanuel Wilson lost 454. The waiver move of the week was a $5 claim on DJ Giddens that it released three days later.

The roster is old where it matters. Mahomes is 31 and Jared Goff (4,033) is 32, and 31% of the value is in players 29 or older, second-highest in the league. Tuten, 23, Sam LaPorta (3,168) and Denzel Boston (2,273) are the young pieces.

The draft capital hasn't changed, and that's the problem. Ben holds one pick in the first three rounds of 2027 and 2028: its own 2028 second, 1,374, last in the league. Its 2027 first belongs to Sheev, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third to Send Nudes, and its 2028 first and third to Bijan.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff team by record, a middle team by scoring, and the thinnest future in the league.
breakdown.move: Ride it out. Spend FAAB, not picks, because Ben has $58 and almost no picks left to trade.

breakdown.headline: 5-3, the Softest Schedule, the Worst Efficiency, and Two 2027 Firsts
p: Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 and 10th in dynasty value at 48,978, down 1,842. It scores 109.7 a game, eighth, and has faced 103.7 a game, the softest schedule in the league. Its luck factor is +2.64, tied with Ben Football Team for the highest, and its all-play record is 2.36 wins. Lineup efficiency is 80%, the lowest in the league. The projected win total is 6.2.

The value losses came at quarterback and receiver. Bryce Young (3,466) lost 595, Kendrick Bourne lost 510 and is on injured reserve, and Kyler Murray (2,239) lost 241 and is out this week with his hamstring. Matthew Golden (4,148), 23, gained 232 and is the most valuable player on the roster. De'Von Achane (3,735) is on injured reserve. The quarterback room is still deep: Young, Murray, Malik Willis (2,018) and Daniel Jones.

The draft capital is fourth in the league at 14,770: two 2027 firsts, its own (projected mid, 3,217) and Bijan's (projected late), three 2027 thirds (Sheev's, Panic Trade Project's and Bijan's), its own and God Bless Vodka's 2028 firsts, and Sheev's 2028 second. Its own 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice, its own 2027 third to Sheev, its own 2028 second to God Bless Vodka and its own 2028 third to Panic.

Clinically, the problem is the lineup, not the roster. Jackie had three starters projected for zero going into Sunday with Willis and Jones on the bench, and Justice Hill scored a 65-yard touchdown for Baltimore on Thursday from its bench as well.
breakdown.verdict: A lucky record, good picks and the least efficient lineup management in the league.
breakdown.move: Set the lineup first. Then sell one of the four quarterbacks to a contender that needs one, while 5-3 still makes Jackie look like a buyer.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 6 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: #StopAsianHate Pays a Third to Swap Lamar's Thumb for C.J. Stroud
tradeGrades.intro: One new trade since Sunday's edition. On Tuesday, two days after Lamar Jackson hurt his throwing thumb on Baltimore's first snap, #StopAsianHate sent him and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third-round pick to Sheev for C.J. Stroud. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade. The four older trades keep the values and grades from the editions that graded them.

trades.title: Lamar Jackson to Sheev for C.J. Stroud

sides.reason: Sheev got 6,552 in market value for a quarterback worth 4,023, a 2,529-point win, and the third-round pick came along for nothing. Lamar is out with a thumb injury that Baltimore says needs surgery and could end his season, but Sheev is 1-7 and its season is effectively over too, so the missed games cost it almost nothing. The risk is age: Lamar turns 30 in January, and Sheev gave up the younger quarterback, Stroud, who is 25. It's still the right buy at the right time for a young roster built to win next year, which now has Lamar, Brock Purdy and Jayden Daniels.

#StopAsianHate needed a healthy quarterback now. Hurts is on injured reserve, Watson is a questionable backup, and at 3-5 it is two games out of sixth with six weeks left. Stroud starts this week at 17.75 and is almost five years younger than Lamar, so the fit is real. But it sold Lamar after his value had already dropped 1,281 since Sunday's rankings, added a third-round pick on top, and the next morning spent $23 on Gardner Minshew II anyway. Right idea, wrong price.

Stroke The Post got a 23-year-old tight end worth 1,616 for a pick worth 1,603, so the value is even. The fit makes sense on paper: Travis Kelce is 37 and Stroke needs his replacement. The timing is the problem. Ferguson is on the Rams' injured reserve with an ankle injury and can't help a 4-3 team now, and the deal used Stroke's last 2027 pick.

Panic Trade Project turned an injured tight end into a second-round pick at market price. Ferguson's value has dropped 161 since last Sunday. A 4-3 team with the league's best luck factor and the 11th-best scoring should be adding picks, and this is Panic's third 2027 second. It doesn't win the trade on value, but it wins on timing.

trades.title: Godwin and Fields to Ben Football Team

sides.reason: Ben Football Team won on market value by 378, Godwin at 1,142 and Fields at 276 for Wicks at 1,040. The fit is mixed. Godwin starts this week at 9.7 projected, but he averaged 7.7 in six starts for Very Naughty Boys, while Wicks averaged 9.8 in five starts for Ben. Fields is Kansas City's backup, and Ben starts Patrick Mahomes, so in superflex he's a sensible handcuff; Ben released Jameis Winston a minute after the trade. The timing works: Ben is 5-1 and 12th in dynasty value, so this is a team cashing in a season it's actually winning.

Very Naughty Boys gave up 378 in market value and got five years younger at receiver. For an 0-6 team that is eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, younger is the right direction, and Godwin's value only drops from here at 30. Wicks starts Monday night against Dallas at 6.35 projected. The knock is the price: it handed a contender a starter and a quarterback handcuff for a smaller return.

ClutchJuice paid a 2028 fifth-round pick for a 24-year-old quarterback worth 697. In superflex, that's about as cheap as a quarterback lottery ticket gets. Drake Maye is its only starting quarterback, and this week it has running back Demond Claiborne in the superflex slot at 0.64 projected. Richardson is Indianapolis's backup and has no Week 7 projection, so he doesn't fix that yet. At 2-4 and 11th in dynasty value, buying a young quarterback is the right move for this team.

FantasyCalc doesn't price fifth-round picks; its 2028 fourth is worth 845, so this pick is worth less than that. Richardson was a backup with no projection, and Very Naughty Boys still has Sam Darnold and Tanner McKee starting, so it didn't lose a lineup piece. But a rebuilding superflex team should be buying 24-year-old quarterbacks, not selling them for a fifth. Twelve minutes later it traded Fields too.

brimley gave up 90 in market value, Brooks at 1,407 for Tucker at 1,317, and that is close to even. The fit is strong: Romeo Doubs is on brimley's IR and DJ Moore is listed out, and Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday and 78.5 in six starts this season. Brooks never scored for brimley and is on NFL injured reserve with an abdomen injury, per Sleeper. A 3-3 team holding sixth place turned a player it couldn't use into a starter, and took him from the team it is tied with.

Panic Trade Project won on value by 90 and got two years younger, which fits its rebuild ranking, seventh in dynasty value. The timing is the problem. It is 3-3, tied with brimley for the last playoff spot, and it sold its leading scorer to brimley hours after his best game, for a running back who can't play right now. Choosing to rebuild is fine. Doing it by strengthening the one team you are chasing, for a player you can't start, is a C.
